Title: LoRa Field POC Deployment & Passive Activity Sensor Conceptualization
Content: Executed first field deployment of LoRa Trap POC node in riparian forest environment (~900m distance, dense canopy, mixed stands). Confirmed RF signal penetration with node at 1.5m and receiver at 1.0m height. Identified failure mode in digital "mechanical break" sensor (alligator clip) due to water conductivity. Proposed ADC-based resistive divider logic to differentiate between short, water-resistance, and open states. Conceptualized "Presence-Pre-Trap" (PPT) nodes using low-power acoustic (gnaw/slap frequency) and dual-PIR vertical gate logic to minimize "Dead Mile" overhead.
